sections.title: Talk about today's weather and your day
sections.content: Combine weather expressions with familiar present-tense verbs to describe what the weather is like and what you do.

sections.title: Weather and activity
rows: It is hot and I drink water.
It is raining and I study at home.
It is sunny and I walk in the park.
Hace sol y camino en el parque.
It is cold and I work.

items.spanish: Hoy hace sol y voy al mercado.
items.english: Today it is sunny and I go to the market.
It is raining and I study at home.

items.spanish: Hace calor y camino por el parque.
items.english: It is hot and I walk through the park.

sections.content: Connect the weather to a familiar activity with y: Hace sol y camino en el parque.
